description: Configure the behaviour of the module here

content.name: awaitBotMessages
content.description: If enabled, the bot will wait ~2 Seconds to make sure no bot like NQN deleted the messages and answered afterwards

content.name: ignoredChannels
content.description: If a ghost ping gets send in one of these configured channels, the bot will not run anti-ghost-ping

content.name: youJustGotGhostPinged
content.default:
%mentions%,
You just got ghost-pinged by %authorMention% with the following message: "%msgContent%"
content.description: This message gets send if a member pings another user and deletes the message afterwards

params.name: mentions
params.description: Mentions of every user that got pinged in the original message
